source: Apple Ads Platform API v1 — Managing Reports (developer.apple.com) cross-checked with apple/apple-ads-platform-api-python spec.version 109

metrics.totalAvgCPI: Average cost per install over total installs (Money)

money_format: {amount: string with up to 2 decimals, currency}; this server returns amount as a float

granularity.HOURLY: Range must start within the last 7 days; not for ads or searchterms; excludes ageRange/gender/countryCode/adminArea/locality group_by
granularity.DAILY: Range must start within the last 90 days and span more than one day
granularity.WEEKLY: Range must start within the last 365 days; end at least 14 days in the past
granularity.MONTHLY: End at least 90 days in the past
granularity.(none): Omit granularity for a single day or for period totals only (totalMetrics only)

time_zone.ORTZ: Organization time zone (default here; searchterms reports require ORTZ)

options.includeRows.EMPTY_METRICS: Rows for entities with no activity; not with group_by

row_shape.granularMetrics: per-period metrics when granularity is set (each carries date)
row_shape.metadata: entity attributes (campaign/ad group/keyword/search term…) plus group_by dimension values

not_available: Conversion, trial, revenue or ROAS metrics are not part of Apple Ads reporting; join installs with your MMP/subscription data externally.
page_size: Apple max 5000; this server caps at MAX_PAGE_SIZE (default 1000)
